report.summary: Critical typo in DSSConfig.__post_init__ (names.ad instead of names.add) causes AttributeError on instantiation. Module docstring promises a content-addressed receipt for every decision, but no receipt generation is visible in this module. Diffusion silently accepts unknown source node IDs, inconsistent with restrict_scores' KeyError for unknown IDs. No concurrency issues found in this read-only slice.
risks: DSSConfig instantiation raises AttributeError due to typo 'names.ad' at the end of __post_init__ (line ~415).
Module docstring guarantee 'every input and decision is represented by a content-addressed receipt' is not fulfilled by the provided code; no receipt objects or hashing of decisions are present.
todos: Fix typo: change 'names.ad' to 'names.add(relation)' in DSSConfig.__post_init__.
Implement receipt generation or update docstring to accurately reflect current capabilities.
Consider validating source node IDs in diffuse_relation_scores to match the strict rejection in restrict_scores.

handoff.suggestion: In DSSConfig.__post_init__, line with 'names.ad' should be 'names.add(relation)'. To address the missing receipt guarantee, either add a receipt generation step that hashes inputs and outputs, or revise the docstring to reflect that receipts are provided by the caller or an external packer not shown in this module.
